categories.main_business_segments: SALA Corporation operates six main business segments: Energy & Solutions (city gas, LP gas, electricity, oil products, and related services), Engineering & Maintenance (civil engineering, construction, equipment installation and maintenance), Housing (custom-built homes, renovations, real estate sales and management), Car Life Support (imported car sales and maintenance), Animal Healthcare (veterinary pharmaceuticals and livestock equipment), and Property (real estate leasing, sales, condominiums, hotels, and hospitality).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced energy distribution systems (including city gas and LP gas networks), renewable energy solutions (such as biomass power and battery storage), construction engineering techniques, high-performance housing technologies (e.g., ZEH, LCCM, all-house air conditioning), and logistics/IT systems for efficient service delivery. In animal healthcare, it utilizes specialized distribution and warehousing for pharmaceuticals and feed additives.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include residential households, commercial and industrial clients (for energy and engineering), homebuyers and property owners (housing and property), car owners (car life support), veterinary clinics, livestock farmers (animal healthcare), and local governments. The company primarily serves the Tokai region (Aichi, Shizuoka, and surrounding prefectures), with a focus on both B2C and B2B markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are concentrated in Japan, especially in Aichi and Shizuoka prefectures, with business activities spanning 22 prefectures. All major assets, sales, and facilities are located domestically, and there is no significant overseas business.
categories.supply_chain_position: SALA Corporation operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain: distributing energy to end-users, providing engineering and construction services, selling finished homes and cars, and delivering animal healthcare products to retailers and end-users. It also engages in some upstream activities through property development and renewable energy generation.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The group’s strategic focus is on regional value creation, carbon neutrality, digital transformation (DX), and business model innovation. Key initiatives include expanding renewable energy and storage, promoting high-efficiency and eco-friendly housing, enhancing customer experience through digitalization, and strengthening collaboration both within the group and with external partners. R&D is not a major cost center, but innovation is pursued through new product launches (e.g., high-insulation homes), system upgrades, and sustainability initiatives.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product and service sales: energy supply (gas, electricity, oil), construction and engineering contracts, home sales and renovations, car sales and maintenance, animal healthcare product distribution, and property leasing and hospitality. Additional income comes from financial services (installment sales, leasing) and information processing.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include regional energy suppliers, national housing and construction firms, large car dealerships, and animal healthcare distributors. The company faces competition from both established players and new entrants, but differentiates itself through integrated regional services, a diversified business portfolio, and strong local brand recognition. It holds a leading position in its core Tokai region markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending November 2024, consolidated net sales were ¥240.5 billion, with operating profit of ¥6.3 billion and net profit attributable to parent shareholders of ¥5.2 billion. The company employs approximately 4,000 people. While sales were slightly down year-on-year due to energy price adjustments, profits improved due to strong housing and cost control. The group continues to invest in growth areas such as renewable energy, housing, and M&A (e.g., acquisition of Yasue Komuten).
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: SALA Corporation emphasizes comprehensive, regionally integrated solutions that enhance quality of life and business productivity. Its value proposition centers on safety, reliability, environmental sustainability (carbon neutrality), and customer-centric service. Differentiation is achieved through a broad service offering, local presence, advanced energy and housing technologies, and a commitment to community development and ESG principles.
